body.sw:
Tunasafirisha oda kote Tanzania Bara, Zanzibar na Pemba.

## Muda wa kufika
- Dar es Salaam: siku 1 ya kazi (Express: siku hiyo hiyo kwa oda kabla ya saa 8 mchana)
- Pwani, Morogoro, Tanga, Dodoma: siku 1–2
- Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Mwanza na Kanda ya Ziwa: siku 2–3
- Zanzibar, Pemba na mikoa mingine: siku 2–4

## Gharama
- Dar es Salaam: TSh 5,000 (BURE kwa oda zaidi ya TSh 300,000)
- Express Dar es Salaam: TSh 10,000
- Mikoa ya karibu: TSh 10,000
- Mikoa mingine: TSh 15,000 – 18,000
- Kuchukua dukani: BURE

## Kupokea oda
Msafirishaji atakupigia simu kabla ya kufika. Tafadhali kagua kifurushi mbele ya msafirishaji. Kwa simu, IMEI iliyo kwenye boksi inapaswa kulingana na ankara yako.
body.en:
We deliver across mainland Tanzania, Zanzibar and Pemba.

## Delivery times
- Dar es Salaam: 1 working day (Express: same day for orders before 2pm)
- Pwani, Morogoro, Tanga, Dodoma: 1–2 days
- Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Mwanza and the Lake Zone: 2–3 days
- Zanzibar, Pemba and other regions: 2–4 days

## Fees
- Dar es Salaam: TSh 5,000 (FREE on orders over TSh 300,000)
- Express in Dar es Salaam: TSh 10,000
- Nearby regions: TSh 10,000
- Other regions: TSh 15,000 – 18,000
- Store pickup: FREE

## Receiving your order
The courier will call you before arriving. Please inspect the package in front of the courier. For phones, the IMEI on the box should match your invoice.

body.sw:
Tunataka uridhike na kila ununuzi.

## Siku 7 za kurejesha
Unaweza kurejesha bidhaa ndani ya siku 7 tangu kuipokea ikiwa:
- Bidhaa haijatumika na iko kwenye boksi lake asilia
- Vifaa vyote na nyaraka zimo
- Una namba ya oda au ankara

## Bidhaa zisizorejesheka
- Vioo vya kulinda skrini vilivyokwisha bandikwa
- Bidhaa zilizoharibiwa na mteja
- Simu ambazo akaunti ya iCloud/Google haijaondolewa

## Jinsi ya kurejesha
Ingia kwenye akaunti yako → Oda Zangu → chagua oda → "Omba Kurejesha". Tutawasiliana nawe ndani ya saa 24. Pesa hurejeshwa kupitia njia uliyolipia ndani ya siku 3–5 za kazi.
body.en:
We want you to love every purchase.

## 7-day returns
You can return an item within 7 days of delivery if:
- It is unused and in its original packaging
- All accessories and documents are included
- You have your order number or invoice

## Non-returnable items
- Screen protectors that have been applied
- Items damaged by the customer
- Phones with iCloud/Google account still linked

## How to return
Log in → My Orders → choose the order → "Request Return". We'll contact you within 24 hours. Refunds go back to your original payment method within 3–5 working days.

body.sw:
Kila bidhaa ya Joh Shopping ina dhamana.

## Muda wa dhamana
- Simu mpya: miezi 12
- Simu zilizotumika (Daraja A/B): miezi 6
- Simu zilizotumika (Daraja C): miezi 3
- Vifaa: miezi 1–18 kulingana na bidhaa (imeonyeshwa kwenye ukurasa wa bidhaa)

## Dhamana inafunika
- Hitilafu za kiwanda kwenye vifaa na programu
- Matatizo ya betri chini ya 80% (simu mpya)

## Dhamana haifuniki
- Kuvunjika kwa skrini au uharibifu wa maji
- Kufunguliwa na fundi asiyeidhinishwa

## Kudai dhamana
Akaunti Yangu → Marejesho na Dhamana → "Dai Dhamana". Weka IMEI ya simu. Matengenezo huchukua siku 3–10 za kazi.
body.en:
Every Joh Shopping product is covered by a warranty.

## Warranty period
- New phones: 12 months
- Used phones (Grade A/B): 6 months
- Used phones (Grade C): 3 months
- Accessories: 1–18 months depending on the item (shown on the product page)

## Covered
- Manufacturing defects in hardware and software
- Battery health below 80% (new phones)

## Not covered
- Cracked screens or liquid damage
- Repairs by unauthorised technicians

## Making a claim
My Account → Returns & Warranty → "Warranty Claim". Enter the phone's IMEI. Repairs take 3–10 working days.

body.sw:
Tunaheshimu faragha yako na tunalinda taarifa zako kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Ulinzi wa Taarifa Binafsi ya Tanzania (2022).

## Taarifa tunazokusanya
- Jina, barua pepe, namba ya simu na anwani ya kufikisha
- Historia ya oda na malipo (hatuhifadhi PIN wala namba kamili ya kadi)

## Tunavyotumia taarifa
- Kushughulikia na kufikisha oda zako
- Kukutumia taarifa za oda na, ukikubali, ofa
- Kuboresha huduma zetu

## Haki zako
Unaweza kuomba nakala, marekebisho au kufutwa kwa taarifa zako wakati wowote kupitia hello@johshopping.co.tz.
body.en:
We respect your privacy and protect your data in line with Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Act (2022).

## What we collect
- Name, email, phone number and delivery address
- Order and payment history (we never store PINs or full card numbers)

## How we use it
- To process and deliver your orders
- To send order updates and, if you opt in, offers
- To improve our services

## Your rights
You can request a copy, correction or deletion of your data at any time via hello@johshopping.co.tz.

body.sw:
Kwa kutumia tovuti ya Joh Shopping unakubali masharti haya.

## Bei na upatikanaji
Bei zote ziko kwa Shilingi za Tanzania (TZS) na zinajumuisha VAT. Bei na upatikanaji vinaweza kubadilika bila taarifa.

## Malipo
Tunapokea kadi za Visa/Mastercard na pesa kwa simu (M-Pesa, Mixx by Yas, Airtel Money, HaloPesa, T-Pesa, AzamPesa). Oda huthibitishwa baada ya malipo kukamilika.

## Akaunti
Una jukumu la kulinda nenosiri lako. Tujulishe mara moja ukihisi akaunti yako imeingiliwa.
body.en:
By using the Joh Shopping website you agree to these terms.

## Prices and availability
All prices are in Tanzanian Shillings (TZS) and include VAT. Prices and availability may change without notice.

## Payments
We accept Visa/Mastercard and mobile money (M-Pesa, Mixx by Yas, Airtel Money, HaloPesa, T-Pesa, AzamPesa). Orders are confirmed once payment is complete.

## Accounts
You're responsible for keeping your password safe. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access.
